description: Hand-reviewed GitHub dataflow cases spanning direct identifiers, low-score generic IDs and numbers, lexical-cap recovery, conflicting resource qualifiers, incidental nested data, and misleading name matches.

cases.label: issue_number
cases.rationale: Issue listing directly exposes each issue number.

cases.label: pull_number
cases.rationale: Pull-request listing directly exposes each pull number.

cases.label: artifact_id
cases.rationale: Artifact listing directly exposes artifact IDs.

cases.label: release_id
cases.rationale: Release listing directly exposes release IDs.

cases.label: environment_name
cases.rationale: Environment listing directly exposes environment names.

cases.label: autolink_id
cases.rationale: Creation returns the new autolink's generic data.id.

cases.label: pages_deployment_id
cases.rationale: Creation returns the deployment ID required by status lookup.

cases.label: key_id
cases.rationale: Creation returns the new deploy key's generic data.id.

cases.label: release_id
cases.rationale: Creation returns the new release ID and is a direct create-to-delete chain.

cases.label: discussion_number
cases.rationale: The producer creates a team discussion and returns its number.

cases.label: milestone_number
cases.rationale: The milestone is incidental nested data on an issue mutation, not the resource operated by the producer.

cases.label: name
cases.rationale: A repository name is not a gitignore template name.

cases.label: client_id
cases.rationale: An issue response cannot provide an OAuth application's client ID.

cases.label: names
cases.rationale: Collaborator response names are not a repository topic-name list.

cases.label: ref
cases.rationale: A codespace's nested ref is incidental and not a discovered Git reference intended for deletion.

cases.label: name
cases.rationale: A deleted column's nested name is not a user-project name dependency.

cases.label: branch_policy_id
cases.rationale: Creation returns the new branch policy's direct generic data.id.

cases.label: discussion_number
cases.rationale: A newly created discussion returns the number consumed by deletion.

cases.label: comment_number
cases.rationale: A newly created discussion comment returns its direct generic number.

cases.label: reaction_id
cases.rationale: The created release reaction's ID is the resource deleted by the consumer.

cases.label: project_number
cases.rationale: Project creation returns a wrapped generic number required by the field operation.

cases.label: reaction_id
cases.rationale: Both values are reaction IDs, but commit-comment and issue-comment reactions are different scoped resources.

cases.label: project_id
cases.rationale: The direct ID returned by adding a field identifies that field, not the enclosing project.

cases.label: issue_number
cases.rationale: A milestone number is not an issue number even though both are generic numeric identifiers.
